name: Outdoor Leisure Cycling

instructions.description: Check the bicycle fit, brakes, helmet, and route.
Begin in an easy gear and accelerate gradually.
Maintain a predictable line and steady cadence.
Slow early and stop in a safe location.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Outdoor Leisure Cycling — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use appropriate safety equipment and a route suited to skill level.
